# Repository instructions

Read `AGENTS.md` and `PROJECT_RULES.md` before proposing or editing any file.
Apply project-local development: experiments, code, evidence, reports, and tests belong in this repository unless a necessary external resource is linked and recorded.
Use short functional names. Name new dated outputs `purpose_YYYYMMDD_HHMM.ext` in Asia/Seoul time, with a numeric suffix if the timestamp collides. Keep stable filenames for code, APIs, package manifests, agent instructions and tools; use Git commits to timestamp code changes.
Do not prepend AIBA to every filename. Preserve upstream, Golden, original artifacts, exact approved scope, copyright/license notices and existing working links. No wholesale renaming.
Report tests and exceptions as PASS/FAIL/HOLD/SKIP; do not claim WJ final approval from automated checks.
